title: Palindrome Query
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 10^6; 1 \leq Q \leq 10^5; S is a string of length N consisting of lowercase English letters.; 1 \leq x \leq N; c is a lowercase English letter.; 1 \leq L \leq R \leq N; N, Q, x, L, R are integers.
